series.tone: Everyday friendship comedy; all three may win, fail, surprise and show affection.

order: This specification for implementation starting dimensions
Individual reference sheets for shape and expression
Group lineup for relationships and palette
Original exploration for historical context only
notes: Images are illustration references, not mathematically consistent orthographic blueprints.
Dimensions and palettes are proposed calibrated starting values, not measurements extracted from images.
Do not import this JSON as an existing viral-engine character definition.

coordinates.unit: metre-like engine world unit; proposed scale
coordinates.origin: Ground between soles at neutral standing pose
coordinates.pose: Relaxed A-pose; hands four digits total, three fingers plus thumb
coordinates.sideConvention: All left/right statements refer to character anatomy, never image position.

shared.defaultFootContact: sole; independent support anchor per foot
shared.materials: Matte broad color blocks; painted/vertex fur markings; sparse fixed tufts; no simulated hair
shared.determinism: Absolute story time with fixed-step reconstructed or baked secondary motion
shared.runtime: Existing CPU software-rendered Three.js path; no paid services or GPU dependency

characters.name: Rusty
identity: Cream cheek masks and brow patches
Small dark blunt nose, short separate muzzle
Six broad dark tail bands; lighter tip; same UV pattern at every pose
Slate-blue closed zip hoodie, hood down, no drawstrings
Fur-covered lower body, bare dark hind paws

behavior.want: To appear cool, capable and independent
behavior.flaw: Conceals how much he wants approval and companionship
behavior.warmth: Generous and deeply pleased when friends choose him
behavior.tell: Tail or ears reveal emotion occasionally, not on every beat

motion.gait: Soft planted steps, modest hip sway, clear weight transfer
motion.reaction: Eyes notice, mouth tries to stay composed, ears/tail reveal feeling
motion.tail: Five to seven joints; broad smooth bends; fixed pattern; floor/body/friend clearance; explicit hold/contact for pinning

characters.name: Pip
identity: Separate head, neck, torso, upper/lower arms and legs
Large sideways leaf ears; one V notch on anatomical LEFT ear outer upper edge
Dark petrol-teal swept hair with dominant tuft toward anatomical RIGHT
Freckles at nose/upper cheeks; small canine accent only in open smiles
Ochre cropped jacket, cream shirt, plum cuffed trousers, brown boots
One russet repair patch on anatomical RIGHT upper outer sleeve; accept individual sheet's upper-arm position, not earlier prompt's elbow wording

behavior.want: To be useful, interesting and part of the adventure
behavior.flaw: Commits before checking the practical details
behavior.warmth: First to help or cheer; sincere when an idea fails
behavior.tell: One ear rises before an idea, both soften on embarrassment

motion.gait: Quicker cadence than Rusty, narrower stance, purposeful forward lean
motion.reaction: Attention shift then ear/brow idea, body commits; avoid continuous fidgeting
motion.ears: One root pivot each plus optional gentle tip bend; notch never changes sides
motion.hair: Fixed sculpted locks, at most two restrained secondary joints

characters.name: Moss
identity: Broad blunt elongated capybara muzzle; gently sloped forehead
Small high rounded ears, dark broad nose, small low mouth
Wide barrel torso, short stocky limbs, planted bare feet
No visible tail, no giant incisors or whisker wires
Sage crewneck sweatshirt, oatmeal pocket on anatomical LEFT chest
Fur-covered lower body; no trousers or shoes

behavior.want: Comfort, peace and a fair share of snacks
behavior.flaw: Can be stubborn or too comfortable to intervene quickly
behavior.tell: Small eye shift, one brow, deliberate hand action

motion.gait: Broad support, slower deliberate cadence; weight moves before a step
motion.reaction: Read thought through eyes and small mouth changes; stillness is purposeful

proposedChannelsNotExistingAPI.notes: Adapt to supported existing fields where semantics match. Implement/validate any new channels explicitly; never silently ignore them.

acceptance.identity: No potato shell, sprout or gold-skin remapping; side views match species; IDs never overwrite legacy cast
acceptance.visual: Matched neutral front/three-quarter/profile/back plus four approved expressions per character
acceptance.motion: Walk-stop-turn, sit/stand, two-hand hold, one-hand release, reaction, secondary motion and random-seek checks
acceptance.regressions: Existing potato tests/golden frames retain baseline; new fixtures include known failures
acceptance.cpu: Profile on same four-core software renderer; record actual geometry/material/draw-call counts and wall time, not promised fps
